name: Ravi Ahuja
review: Ambience ok but food is good especially if you like seafood. Thalis are amazing. Prawns Rice was also nice though very oily inspite of telling the waiter clearly to put less oil for us. Surmai Fry and Pomfret are good too. Must try once atleast if you are in Thane.

name: siddhant kabra
review:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at here, and I must say, the food quality and taste are absolutely amazing. Every dish was flavorful and well-prepared, leaving a lasting impression. The service also deserves a special mention for being attentive and efficient, enhancing the overall dining experience.

While the restaurant may not boast a premium ambiance or luxurious seating, it certainly does not disappoint when it comes to the quality and taste of its food. The focus here is clearly on delivering exceptional culinary delights.

One downside to note is the parking situation. Finding a spot can be quite challenging, especially during weekends and holidays. Planning ahead or considering alternative transportation might be a good idea if you're visiting during peak times.

Overall, it's a fantastic place for food lovers who prioritize taste and quality over upscale decor. Highly recommended!

name: Alex Mercer
review:
Best hotel in the area for enjoying veg/nonveg thali with drinks !

This hotel serves some of the cheapest and yet worthy food in the area

They hav alot of seating available, there is also a private place to sit down and enjoy it traditional style.

Surmai fry thali (330/-) size is pretty good
Pomfret thali (550/-)

You can enjoy all kinds of alcohol drinks here at affordable price (no smoking allowed)

They provide complimentary 'chakna'

name: Priyanka Thakkar
review: I have been coming here since my childhood and last year's I wasn't in Thane yesterday I visited this place after years food has become average but when it comes to service is pathetic waiters act as if they are serving u for free they won't talk in hindi and keep talking to u in Marathi and if feels like some unsafe place where they might attact u if u say anything to them these waiters are goons ( gunda) specially one who takes the order they act if the food is free and they are helping poor people . name: Avinash Milwani
review: One of the best places in Thane for having Malvani style non-vegetarian and seafood.Their Fish Thalis are delicious.I am a regular and have tried the Surmai thali, Pomfret thali and Chicken Thali.The thali contains one slice of fried fish with Malvani Curry,one vegetable dish,2 chapatis/1bhakri, a bowl of rice and Sol Kadi as an appetizer.Always found the quality and preparation upto the mark.It is very reasonably priced for the quality and quantity served.The restaurant accepts UPI /Card /Cash/ Sodexo/ Pluxee cards.

name: Deepak
review:
It's a nice place, usually have to wait for 10-15 min on the weekends, good authentic malvani cuisine. Chicken thali is better than surmai thali, In prawns fry prawns are not cooked well from inside. And in thali I suggest the host to skip Suki machi bhaji. Solkadi, Bhakri, Surmai everything was fresh and awesome.
You will not get any Chinese dish here including chicken lolipop. The best thing is that the natural ice cream shop is nearby hotel malvan. The place is a bit noisy as it's a family restaurant. Good place to go with your friends and family to make some more noise. Bon appetite. Adios.

name: Dominic Savio Braganza
review:
We tried the Surmai Tawa Fry, Bombil Rawa Fry, Rawas Masala Fry, Rawas Curry, Rawas Fry and Steam Rice, Vades. Just Super and Authentic Malvani food.
You can order just Fish Rassa, if you don't want a curry fish.
The Rawas Curry and Surmai Tawa Fry (with a light coating of rawa) was one of the best I've had. Absolutely Amazing.
End with a well balanced Solkadi.
The ambience is simple and average, but clean. Nothing fancy.
Prices are reasonable, considering 'its fish'.
They also serve a variety of dishes in Mutton, Chicken and are also famous for their Thalis.
Service is fast and the waiters will gladly explain you the dishes in case you enquire.
Situated at Panch Pakhadi area of Thane close to the junction.

name: Raghav Gujarati
review:
Well this place is strictly for non vegetarians.
Good ambience. They serve alcohol  too but still comfortable for families.
Since i am vegetarian and i was there with friends i had to choose from very few vegetarian options. I would definitely not suggest this for vegetarians and based on my friends feedback, must try for non vegetarians to taste authentic Maharashtrian food. We have been there on Friday evening so had to wait for 15 minutes.

name: oaindrila das
review: Very delicious Malwani food!! It's reasonably priced. We tried crab, prawns, Bombil, pomfret & shell fish. Loved the taste! It's located at Pachpakhadi & can be easily reached from Thane West station road.

name: Aditi Datta
review:
Hotel Malwan has been my go-to dining destination for over two decades, and I can confidently attest to the consistent quality and delightful taste of their cuisine. Located in the heart of Thane, the restaurant offers a welcoming and homely ambiance, creating the perfect setting for indulging in some of the finest Malwani dishes.

Among my personal favorites, the Bheja Sukkha and Mutton Liver Sukkha are absolute must-tries. The Bombil Fry is a delightful delicacy that should not be missed, and their Mutton Bhaat is a true masterpiece. the chicken and various fish items on their menu are equally delectable.
If you're a fan of Malwani cuisine, Hotel Malwan is the place to be.

name: Omkar Ambre
review: This restaurant offers you wide variety of malvani food and having drinks facility. As i visited many reastaurant offering mouth watering kokani food and i my native is kokan i felt this one is failed to give you best tatse. If you are die hard fan of malvani non veg food this restaurant will quite disappoint you .and it is expensive but give you best family time.

name: Rohan Hire
review: I am a great fan of this restaurant, actually. But whenever I take a parcel from this hotel, they always have me stale fish. It has happened three times now. I hope the owner will change this policy.

name: Kirti Bhole
review: Finger-licking good Malvani mutton and Prawns Chutney (get it as dry starter instead of gravy)!! They usually have all sorts of fresh fish available according to the season - bombil(Bombay Duck), paplet(Pomfret), rawas(Salmon), surmai(Kingfish), mori(Shark), kolambi(Prawns), tisrya(Clams), makhli(Squid & Octopus), jawla(Baby Shrimp). We also order the jawla fritter extra spicy with green chillies whenever they have it. Bheja fry and liver tawa fry are good and so are the rice bhakri and malvani vade. Prawns khichadi is loaded with prawns.

name: Marica Dsouza
review:
1. Prawns koliwada: Tasty, not spicy. Enjoyed it.
2. Surmai fry: Good portion but the masala was not tasty, just very spicy not flavourful
3. Fish thali: Again it was okay just spicy. Nothing great flavour wise
4. Mutton Thali: The mutton sukha was amazing! Thali was good in size too. Enjoyed it.

name: Reshma Lokhande
review: We ordered three different types of thali. Ravas thali, Surmai thali and bheja fry thali. The taste was authentic and good.. Fish lovers must visit this hotel...

name: Meenal Kedare
review: I went there for dinner. Food is very delicious....If you are a crab lover then visit here.....tawa surmai, chicken bhat nd Crab was so yummy nd price is also reasonable.

name: Amar Rao
review: Restaurant served with liquor. Service is good. Had ordered Surmai fry thali and Bombil fry. Surmai fry was approximately Rs. 350, which is quite reasonable. Surmai fry was fresh but not big. Fish gravy served in the thali was tasteless. Bombil fry was fresh. Quality of food can definitely improve.

name: 18_Shambhavi Patkar
review: This place is been my favorite since childhood times. I have fond memories of dinner time with family and it's one of the oldest best restaurant for sea food in thane. I happened to visit it after years and it has got even better with time. I had pompfret thali, chicken pakoda and Bangda fry. And each item I had left taste buds satisfied. The preparation of meat and sea food is very fresh also the staff is very friendly

name: sergio d'souza
review: No fresh fish on Monday and Tuesday, we as a  family visited, no major fish dishes like bombil, teesra ect. Solkadi was not upto the mark. Standard has gone down, compared to our last visit

name: narendra jadhav
review: Its worst experience it is not malavani food sarvice is poor and also miss bevihar staff nott good suggested not this restaurant its gobar

name: V R
review: Tried out bombil fry no flavours at all just dipped in rawa and deep fried surmai tawa fry thali was better as well as the chicken sukka thali

name: Swaps G
review: The taste here, I know, is amazing but the wait times are too much at peak. 45 mins of queue to just to enter and another 15 mins just to place the order. It's already been more than an hour and I am still not sure how long it will be before food is served.

name: sanika khot
review:
The food here is fantastic they serveauthentic Malvani cuisine.
Must try are their thaalis and prawns fry.

name: Deepak Poojari
review:
I had visited Hotel Malvan after a long time. This time I really did not like the quality of the food. I tried bombil fry but it was totally not up to the mark...it was very oily and size were also too small. I ordered 1 chicken thali it was average not that great. Ordered extra bhakri it was soft but it was already prepared and warm.

You can try here thalis which are quite affordable. Drinks are severed here.

name: Aditya Tawade
review: This restaurant offers some of the best-tasting seafood and chicken/mutton dishes that are truly unmatched. The service is excellent, and the atmosphere is both beautiful and inviting.

name: Vinit Kale
review:
Good food, also you can order alcohol. Family friendly place, not a quite place, people are always on the top of their voice. Not the staff but people who are having dinner.

Coming to food, the thali options are good. Mutton thali is especially good, tho this place is known for fish specialities.

Overall good place, parking can be a issue. Waiting times are approximately 15-20 minutes.

name: Dilip Bhogale
review: Awesome Food... Authentic Malvani food served here....Fish served fresh and nicely prepared..We have tried Fried Prawns, Surmai Tawa Fry, Pomfret Tawa Fry, Bombil Tawa Fry, Halwa fry, Rawas Curry, Solkadi... everything is exceptional in terms of taste, presentation and most importantly value for money...

name: aniket gawade
review:
If you crave for good thalis , malvan is your place.
Fish is fresh .
Order sukka chicken thali, fish thali.
Their kolambhi bhaat is great.
Service is top notch
It is crowdy on weekends so try and go early .

name: superstar nikhyl
review: Sea food restaurant with bar. Authentic malvani cuisine. Food quality and taste is good.

name: Nikhil Kongo
review: Still one of the best places to enjoy malavani food in thane. Surmai tawa fry is all time favorite. Also bombil fry is must try. I also like bheja fry.This is a popular eatery in thane. Mostly crowded on weekends and Wednesday.Must visit
